description: Composite three-panel microstructure figure of the hot-rolled specimen, every panel stamped "HR" in its top-right corner and carrying a small orientation inset. (a) Optical micrograph of the RD-ND plane (ND up, RD right), 50 µm scale bar: a strongly banded structure of alternating light and dark bands elongated parallel to RD; a red arrow labels the dark band α and a blue arrow labels the light band γ. (b) Optical micrograph of the RD-TD plane (TD up, RD right), 50 µm scale bar: equiaxed to irregular grains with a dark boundary network and pronounced contrast inhomogeneity, the blue arrow marking γ and the red arrow marking α. (c) SEM micrograph of the RD-TD plane (TD up, RD right), 2 µm scale bar: grey α grains, a darker continuous γ region, and bright white particles decorating the boundaries, orange-arrowed as κ-carbide. No numeric values are printed other than the three scale bars. Taken together, the figure argues that the hot-rolled condition is banded in the RD-ND section, strongly inhomogeneous with large α and γ areas in the RD-TD section, and that κ-carbide lies along α/γ and α/α boundaries.

subfigures.description: Optical micrograph of the RD-ND plane, 50 µm scale bar, orientation inset with ND up and RD right, label 'HR'. Shows a banded structure of thin, elongated alternating light/dark bands lying along RD. Red arrow labelled α sits on a dark band, blue arrow labelled γ on a light band.

Optical micrograph of the RD-TD plane, 50 µm scale bar, orientation inset with TD up and RD right, label 'HR'. Shows equiaxed/irregular grains with dark grain-boundary network; blue arrow labelled γ and red arrow labelled α mark contrasting regions. Microstructure appears inhomogeneous.

SEM micrograph of the RD-TD plane, 2 µm scale bar, orientation inset with TD up and RD right, label 'HR'. Grey α grains and a darker γ region separated by boundaries decorated with bright white particles; an orange arrow labels κ (κ-carbide). Individual carbide shapes are near the resolution limit.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is an optical micrograph of the RD-ND plane showing a banded structure of thin, elongated alternating bands aligned with the rolling direction, with a red arrow labelled α and a blue arrow labelled γ.

Panel (b) is an optical micrograph of the RD-TD plane showing equiaxed/irregular grains, a dark boundary network and a strongly non-uniform contrast, with a blue arrow labelled γ and a red arrow labelled α.
Panel (c) is an SEM micrograph of the RD-TD plane in which bright white particles decorate the boundaries between grey α regions and a darker γ region, with an orange arrow labelling κ (κ-carbide).
Scale bars read 50 µm in panels (a) and (b) and 2 µm in panel (c); all three panels are stamped 'HR' and carry orientation insets ((a) ND up/RD right; (b) and (c) TD up/RD right).

The caption states that (a) is an OM micrograph of the RD-ND plane, (b) an OM micrograph of the RD-TD plane, and (c) an SEM micrograph of the RD-TD plane, with RD = rolling direction, ND = normal direction and TD = transverse direction.
The citing text states that panel (a) shows a typical banded structure with coarse ferrite formed during the early stage of solidification.

The citing text states that the microstructure in panel (b) is very inhomogeneous and is described by a large α phase area and a γ phase area (each continuous area mainly of one phase with dispersed γ or α and κ-carbide).
The citing text states that the SEM micrograph in Fig. 3(c) clearly shows κ-carbide along ferrite/austenite (α/γ) and ferrite/ferrite (α/α) boundaries.

The citing text states that EDS confirms α phase as Al-rich, γ phase as Mn-rich and C-rich, and κ-carbide as Mn-rich and Al-rich; this is an assertion about the labelling, not a measurement visible in the micrographs.

unreadable_items: panel (c): individual κ-carbide particle sizes/morphologies are at the resolution limit and cannot be measured
